subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Rollover Crash Engineering
description: A quick win: understand Rollover Crash Engineering.

hook.text: SUVs with high centers of gravity were infamous for flipping during emergency swerves.

buildup.text: A rollover strips away every safety layer—the roof caves in, belts strain, airbags misfire.

discovery.text: Engineers strengthened roof pillars and launched electronic stability control to stop rollovers.

twist.text: ESC was so effective it cut single-vehicle crash deaths by roughly 50 percent in SUVs.

climax.text: Since 2012, every new car sold in the US must include electronic stability control by law.

punchline.text: The best rollover protection stops the roll before it starts.

quiz.question: What technology most effectively prevents SUV rollovers?
